core_obligations: Reduce to affines: a section over a qc open of the limit is a ring element in the colimit on each affine of a finite cover.
Tensor-colimit commutation: the structure sheaf of the limit pulls back to the colimit of the pulled-back structure sheaves on the finite pieces.
Glue the affine statements to the qqc section statement.
